clue.text: Declining years not without love

parts.note: a decade is a run of ten years

indicators.note: without tells us to take the following letter away from the word before it

parts.note: taken as written before its letter is removed
love is nil in tennis scoring, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone describes their twilight years as not lacking in romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes O (love) from NOT, leaving NT to follow DECADE.
explanation.definitionFit: Decadent describes a society or art in moral or cultural decline, so it fits declining as an adjective.

clue.text: Cold bird has no chance of surviving

definitions.note: the definition is a phrase describing a thing, while the answer is the noun for such a thing

parts.note: a cold body is a dead one
a duck is a common water bird

explanation.surface: A bird out in the freezing weather looks unlikely to make it.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: a dead duck is a plan or person with no chance of success, so the descriptive phrase stands for the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a dead duck is a scheme or person already doomed to failure.

clue.text: Tropic isle — a hard place to find on foot

parts.note: Capri is the island in the Bay of Naples

parts.words: a hard place to find on foot
parts.note: a corn is a hardened patch of skin, typically on a toe

explanation.surface: Searching an island holiday spot, someone finds the ground hard underfoot.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tropic of Capricorn is the southern line of latitude bounding the tropics.

clue.text: At the proper time receiving money without enthusiasm

indicators.note: receiving means the first word takes the other inside it

parts.note: something done duly is done when it should be
L stands for pound (libra), the British unit of money

explanation.surface: Being paid on time, the recipient shows no excitement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receiving' puts L inside DULY.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in a flat, boring, listless way, which is how something dully done comes across.

clue.text: He's very mean when grading is involved

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters of grading become tangled up into a new order

explanation.surface: A stingy teacher marks harshly whenever grades are at stake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is involved' signals an anagram of GRADING.
explanation.definitionFit: A niggard is a miser, someone who grudges every penny spent.

clue.text: Caledonian retreating in alarm .

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the word Scot is read right to left

parts.note: Caledonia is the old name for Scotland, so a Caledonian is a Scot

explanation.surface: A Scotsman falls back in panic, the clue running on into the next.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreating' turns SCOT round to give TOCS, then IN follows. The dots carry the sentence on into 10 across, which has its own answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tocsin is an alarm bell or warning signal.

clue.text: A proportion comes in to start working

indicators.note: comes in means this piece goes inside the other word

parts.note: to open is to start or begin something
a ratio is a proportion between two quantities

explanation.surface: A share of profits arrives just as a business begins trading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes in' puts RATIO inside OPEN, between OPE and N.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine in operation is running or functioning, so the noun answers to working in that sense.

clue.text: You can get to grips with the development of this young man

indicators.note: a development is a working-out into a new form, so the letters of grips are rearranged

explanation.surface: A youngster who can tackle problems as he grows up.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites us to develop 'this' answer into GRIPS; equivalently, rearranging GRIPS gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Sprig is an old, slightly dismissive word for a youth or young fellow, like a shoot off the family tree.

clue.text: Girl's given head covering — she has no clothes

indicators.note: covering means the first piece wraps round the other

parts.note: nut is slang for the head
Di is a short girl's name, here with its 's

explanation.surface: A girl receives a hat, though she wears nothing else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' puts DIS inside NUT. The possessive 's supplies the S.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who goes naked by choice, as at a naturist beach.

clue.text: Toast in hock.

definitions.meaning: to drink a toast to someone, wishing them well
pawned, held as security for a debt, hock also being a white wine

explanation.surface: A drink raised in glasses of German white wine.
explanation.definitionFit: To pledge someone is to drink their health; a pledge is also something pawned, left in hock as security.

clue.text: . to shock half the Highland Region

indicators.note: half asks for the first half of the word for that region

parts.note: Appalachia is the upland region of the eastern United States around the Appalachian Mountains

explanation.surface: Continuing 5 across, a Scot in alarm, shocked by half the Highlands.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital R makes 'Highland Region' look Scottish, carrying on from 5 across, but it is Appalachia in America. Its first five letters, half of the ten, give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To appal is to horrify or dismay someone, a synonym of shock.

clue.text: A composite sceptre carried by Midas?

definitions.meaning: a plant of the daisy family, botanists' old Compositae
a staff that the king's touch has turned to gold

explanation.surface: The king with the golden touch holds a staff of state.
explanation.definitionFit: Goldenrod is a yellow-flowered plant of the daisy family, once called Compositae; anything Midas held, a rod included, would turn to gold.

clue.text: Many come back and help farm worker

indicators.note: come back means the word is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: a myriad is a great many
aid means help

explanation.surface: Lots of people return to lend a hand on a farm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'come back' turns MYRIAD round to give DAIRYM, then AID follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A dairymaid was a woman employed to milk cows and make butter on a farm.

clue.text: For example, one's after a shield

indicators.note: after says these two pieces come behind the A in the answer

parts.note: one is I, and one's is I'S, written as IS

explanation.surface: Someone illustrates a point, then reaches for a shield.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts EG and IS after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Aegis was the shield of Zeus or Athena, hence any protection or sponsorship.

clue.text: Timed hit

explanation.surface: A punch that was perfectly judged.
explanation.definitionFit: A runner is clocked with a stopwatch, and slang says someone clocked is struck in the face.

clue.text: Building commissioner in Xanadu

parts.note: a nod to Coleridge's poem, whose opening says that in Xanadu a stately pleasure-dome was decreed by the Mongol emperor

explanation.surface: An official in charge of planning in an exotic city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Building commissioner' sounds like a civic job title, but it means the ruler who ordered a palace to be built.
explanation.definitionFit: Coleridge's poem names the Mongol emperor as the man who decreed the pleasure-dome built in Xanadu.

clue.text: It's hard to understand changes in game

indicators.note: changes says the letters of in game shift into a new order

explanation.surface: Rule changes make a game baffling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changes' signals an anagram of IN GAME.
explanation.definitionFit: An enigma is a puzzle or mystery, something baffling.

clue.text: Enter right into mother's celebration

indicators.note: into means these letters go inside the word for mother's

parts.note: mama is mother, so mother's is MAMAS
to enter is to go in

explanation.surface: Someone is invited to walk straight into their mum's party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts RT and IN inside MAMAS, between MA and MAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Martinmas is the feast of St Martin on 11 November, a church festival.

clue.text: Soothes apes repeatedly falling out

indicators.note: falling out suggests a quarrel and disorder, so the letters are mixed up
repeatedly asks for the word apes to be written twice over

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone calms down monkeys that keep squabbling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repeatedly' doubles APES; 'falling out' rearranges the eight letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To appease is to placate or pacify, as one soothes an angry person.

clue.text: Nubia's put forward a deity

indicators.note: put forward means a letter of the word is moved up to the front

parts.note: the region's name with its 's, giving the letters as written

explanation.surface: An ancient African land presents one of its gods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put forward' moves the A of NUBIAS to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Anubis is the jackal-headed Egyptian god of the dead.

clue.text: Give insufficient attention to one dish

parts.note: to scamp a job is to do it carelessly
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A diner who barely notices a single plate of food.
explanation.walkthrough: To scamp is a less familiar verb meaning to skimp on work.
explanation.definitionFit: Scampi is a dish of breaded langoustine tails, a pub-menu staple in Britain.

clue.text: Band appears outside an exotic hot spot

indicators.note: outside says the first word goes round the second

parts.note: a strap is a band of leather or fabric
un is French for an, the foreign word marked by exotic

explanation.surface: A music group performs abroad at a sunny resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts STRAP round UN. Exotic means a foreign language, here French.
explanation.definitionFit: A suntrap is a sheltered sunny spot, such as a walled garden, that catches the heat.

clue.text: Japanese commander captures opponent's last weapon

indicators.note: captures means the commander's title holds the other letter inside

parts.note: a shogun was a military ruler of feudal Japan

indicators.note: last says only the final letter of opponent's is needed

explanation.surface: A Japanese general takes his enemy's final arm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last' takes T from opponent's, ignoring the 's; 'captures' puts it inside SHOGUN.
explanation.definitionFit: A shotgun is a smooth-bore firearm, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Determined attempt on behalf of little creature outside

indicators.note: outside says the creature's name goes round the other piece

parts.note: an eft is a young newt
for means on behalf of

explanation.surface: A hard try made for the sake of a tiny animal out in the open.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts EFT round FOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An effort is a strenuous try or exertion.

clue.text: A boy turns into a girl

indicators.note: turns means the boy's name is read backwards

parts.note: Rolf is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A boy transforms into a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' reverses ROLF to FLOR; the clue's opening A goes on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Flora is a girl's name.

clue.text: Tender made from iron, right?

parts.note: of means made from, as in a ring of gold
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A bid for something made of iron, asked as a question.
explanation.walkthrough: Tender here is the verb or noun of making a bid, not soft.
explanation.definitionFit: To tender is to put forward a bid, so it means the same as proffering.

clue.text: Make up for holding child back formerly

indicators.note: holding means the first word takes the other inside it

parts.note: to atone is to make amends

indicators.note: back means the word for child is read backwards

parts.note: a mite is a small child

explanation.surface: Someone makes amends after once keeping a youngster back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns MITE into ETIM; 'holding' puts it inside ATONE, between ATON and E.
explanation.definitionFit: At one time means formerly, once, in the past.

clue.text: In here the loveliest girl can be seen

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the following words

explanation.surface: A beauty pageant: the prettiest girl can be found right here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In ... can be seen' shows ETHEL running across 'here the loveliest'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethel is a girl's name.

clue.text: Being of small size, he and Margaret are not specially suited

parts.note: taken as written
ft, a foot, is a small measure of length
taken as written
Peg is a pet form of Margaret

explanation.surface: A small man and his wife Margaret are poorly matched.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Suited' looks like a matter of compatibility, but it means dressed in a suit: ready-made clothes are not tailored for the wearer. FT for 'small size' is a loose stretch by the setter.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothes bought off the peg are ready-made, not tailored to one person's measurements.

clue.text: Sing us an earthy composition

parts.note: to hum is to sing with closed lips

explanation.surface: A request to perform a folk song about the soil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composition' suggests a song, but means what soil is made of.
explanation.definitionFit: Humus is the dark organic matter in soil formed from decayed plants.

clue.text: Power in the county

definitions.meaning: the surname of the actor ... Power, star of swashbucklers

explanation.surface: Authority wielded within a shire.
explanation.definitionFit: Tyrone Power was a Hollywood film star, and Tyrone is a county of Northern Ireland.

clue.text: The result of breaking down broken nails, say

indicators.note: broken says the letters of nails, say are smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: A tally of broken fingernails, for instance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' signals an anagram of NAILS SAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Analysis is the separating of something into its parts for study.
